envelopeId.description: Identifier of the DocuSign envelope that was voided

status.description: Envelope status after the successful operation, voided

400.description: Invalid parameters, missing, blank, or overlong voidedReason, missing DocuSign configuration, or an envelope that is not eligible to be voided.

403.description: Write access to the selected document or artifact is denied

404.description: Document, artifact, or associated DocuSign envelope not found

502.description: DocuSign authentication failure, upstream error, or invalid response

504.description: DocuSign request timed out; the void operation outcome is unknown
